3.initial: This test case verifies DPD default settings work properly.
3.title: Default Settings
3.result:
1- Boot both initiator and responder to factory defaults and then configure LAN and WAN.
  2- Go to VPN Advanced page, and DPD would have following default settings.
  -Enable Dead Peer Detection checkbox checked
  - Dead Peer Detection Interval = 60 seconds
  - Failure Trigger Level = 3 missed heartbeats
  - "Enable Dead Peer Detection for Idle VPN sessions" checkbox unchecked
  3- Configure VPN Policy on both initiator and responder with keepalive disabled.
  4- Bring up the tunnel by sending continuous ping to the responder.
  5- Disconnect the WAN port of responder.
